name: Fly.io Deployment
description: Deploy and manage containerized apps on Fly.io — Machines API, secrets management, and log streaming.

requiredSecrets.name: FLY_API_TOKEN
requiredSecrets.reason: Fly.io personal access token from fly.io/user/personal_access_tokens

postInstallNotes:
1. Generate a Fly.io token at fly.io/user/personal_access_tokens.
2. `listMachines()` returns all Machines in the app — useful for monitoring or orchestration.
3. For deployments, use the `flyctl` CLI in CI/CD pipelines with `FLY_API_TOKEN` set.
